venues.name: Day Air Ballpark

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: Contact (937) 228-BATS (2287) for information on season tickets, group outings, and individual tickets, or visit the www.daytondragons.com on line.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office will open on Wednesday, March 21st at 10:00 a.m. Normal box office hours are Monday through Friday, 10:00 am - 5:00pm, Saturdays & Sundays 12:00pm until the middle of the 7th inning (game days only).
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover and Cash.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call orders can be picked up starting 2 hours prior to the event start time. Customers must have their confirmation number, a picture ID, and the actual credit card used to place the order.

venues.parkingDetail: There are 8,400 street, public and private parking spaces within a 1/2 mile walk to the stadium.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Contact the Dayton Dragons Box Office for accessible seating.

generalInfo.generalRule: Due to increased security and for the safety of fans, please be advised that the following items will NOT be permitted into Day Air Ballpark: Laser pointers Lawn Chairs Coolers Bags Backpacks Food Cans, bottles, plastic and boxed liquids, or containers of any kind Signs/Banners The following will be permitted, but are subject to inspection: Medium size purses Fanny packs Large camera cases Diaper Bags (only if accompanied by a child) Strollers (only if accompanied by a child) Radios (only if hand held) Binoculars Cameras Umbrellas Blankets Please note that ALL personal belongings will be subject to inspection upon entry to the stadium. Smoking is not permitted inside the stadium, however designated smoking areas are provided.
generalInfo.childRule: All patrons over the age of 2 need a game ticket (children 2 and under are free, but it is expected that they sit on the lap of an adult).

ada.adaPhones: Contact (937) 228-BATS (2287) for season or group tickets.
ada.adaCustomCopy:
To better accommodate your needs, Day Air Ballpark has requested that all accessible seating ticket accommodations be solicited only through their representatives. Please contact a Day Air Ballpark representative for further help with your ticket purchase.*   Advance ticket purchase may be required. 
 
* Box office information is subject to change.
ada.adaHours: For the 2022 season the box office will open at 10:00 am until 5:00pm.
